solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Strong cord from California that gaffer uses temporarily at first

parts.note: CA is the US postal abbreviation for California

indicators.note: at first asks for only the opening letter of each of the four words before it

parts.note: the initial letters of these four words

explanation.surface: A film crew's gaffer brings a tough Californian rope to tie things down for now.
explanation.walkthrough: A gaffer is the chief electrician on a film set, which suits the California picture.
explanation.definitionFit: Catgut is a tough string made from animal intestines, used for racquets, instruments and surgical stitches.

clue.text: In America bought vehicle having a particular purpose

indicators.note: In tells us the letters sit inside the words that follow, spanning the gap between them

parts.note: the end of America runs into the start of bought

explanation.surface: Someone buys a special-purpose vehicle while in the United States.
explanation.definitionFit: A cab is a car with a specific job, carrying fare-paying passengers, or the driver's compartment of a lorry.

clue.text: Note about skating area over time seen as worthless item

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the note goes round the skating area

parts.note: te is the seventh note of the sol-fa scale
a rink is an ice or roller skating surface
T is the standard abbreviation for time

explanation.surface: An old note about the ice rink, ignored for ages, now seems worthless.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'over' puts the earlier piece above the later one, so T(RINK)E sits on top of T.
explanation.definitionFit: A trinket is a small ornament or piece of cheap jewellery of little real value.

clue.text: Not possible to make out?

parts.note: un- is the prefix meaning not
to fashion something is to make or shape it
the suffix -able means capable of being done

explanation.surface: A puzzled question about something too dark or blurred to read.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 'not possible to make' as un-, fashion, -able, with the parts taken in the order a word builds them; the question mark flags the playful split.
explanation.definitionFit: Out as an adjective means no longer in vogue, which is exactly what an unfashionable style has become.

clue.text: Friend coming back with excellent computer

indicators.note: something coming back travels the opposite way, so the word for friend is read from right to left

parts.note: a pal is a friend
top means first-rate

explanation.surface: A mate returns with a brilliant new computer.
explanation.definitionFit: A laptop is a portable personal computer small enough to rest on your knees.

clue.text: My story of a guy with poor habit being reformed

indicators.note: reformed means made over into a new shape, so the letters before it are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A reformed bad lad tells his own tale of kicking a poor habit.
explanation.definitionFit: An autobiography is a life story written by its own subject, so the writer would call it my story.

clue.text: Headdress seen in Tahiti, a rarity

indicators.note: seen in says the letters can be spotted lying inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run from the end of Tahiti through a into rarity

explanation.surface: A jewelled crown on a South Sea island would be quite unusual.
explanation.definitionFit: A tiara is a jewelled ornamental band or crown worn on the head, often by royalty or brides.

clue.text: Men spy duo concocting alias

indicators.note: concocting means cooking up or inventing, so the letters are mixed into something new

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Two male secret agents invent a cover name.
explanation.definitionFit: A pseudonym is a false name adopted by an author or agent to hide their real identity.

clue.text: Cheese fine initially, but not long

parts.note: Brie is a soft French cheese

indicators.note: initially points to just the opening letter of the word before it

parts.note: the first letter of fine

explanation.surface: The cheese starts off fine but does not last long.
explanation.definitionFit: Brief is an adjective for something short in duration or length, the opposite of lengthy.

clue.text: Thick soup's a new starter in this country building

indicators.note: a new starter says the word for the soup keeps everything but its opening letter, which is swapped for another in this answer

parts.note: pottage is an old word for a thick soup or stew

explanation.surface: A recipe note: the thick soup gets a fresh first course in this rustic house.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue does not say which letter replaces P; the definition and crossers settle on C.
explanation.definitionFit: A cottage is a small house, typically one standing in a village or rural area.

clue.text: One reluctant to describe shellfish?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: someone who ... up and will not give details

explanation.walkthrough: To clam up is to refuse to speak, so a tight-lipped person can be called one; the question mark flags this looser sense.
explanation.definitionFit: The bivalve shuts its shell tight, giving the idiom for someone who keeps quiet and refuses to talk.

clue.text: When ultimately stuck, make request

parts.note: as can mean when, as in 'as I left'

indicators.note: ultimately means in the end, so only the closing letter of the next word counts

parts.note: the final letter of stuck

explanation.surface: Advice: if you end up stuck, just ask for help.
explanation.definitionFit: To ask is to put a question or appeal to someone in order to obtain something.

clue.text: Fitting to include soldier with American instruments

indicators.note: to include means to take in, so the soldier goes inside the word for fitting

parts.note: apt means suitable or fitting
a para is a paratrooper
US is short for the United States

explanation.surface: A US soldier is fitted out with American kit.
explanation.definitionFit: Apparatus is a collective noun for the equipment or set of tools needed for a particular task.

clue.text: At sea? Right!

parts.note: surface reading: someone confused or lost, then agreeing emphatically
setter's reading: the nautical word for the right-hand side of a ship facing forward

explanation.walkthrough: At sea usually means bewildered, and Right! sounds like a reply; together they ask for the sailor's word for right.
explanation.definitionFit: On a vessel, the right-hand side looking towards the bow has its own seafaring name, the opposite of port.

clue.text: Postscript about Greek letter used wrong way round in dialect

indicators.note: about means around, so the postscript abbreviation wraps the Greek letter

parts.note: PS is the abbreviation for postscript

indicators.note: wrong way round says the Greek letter is written backwards

parts.note: iota is the ninth Greek letter

explanation.surface: A letter's postscript misuses a Greek character in some regional speech.
explanation.definitionFit: Patois is the local spoken form of a language, a regional variety differing from the standard.

clue.text: Usual thing — article describing conquest

definitions.note: an adjective phrase: the word that describes the famous Conquest of 1066

parts.note: the norm is the usual or standard thing
an is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A piece of writing about a typical military victory.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Describing' looks like a container signal, but here it is part of the definition: the word that describes the Conquest.
explanation.definitionFit: The Norman Conquest was William of Normandy's invasion of England in 1066, the most famous conquest in English history.

clue.text: Cocktail from Caribbean island that Parisian avoids

indicators.note: avoids means leaves out, so the French word is dropped from the island's name

parts.note: Martinique is a French island in the Caribbean
que is French for that, and a Parisian speaks French

explanation.surface: A drink from a Caribbean island that a Parisian visitor steers clear of.
explanation.definitionFit: A martini is a classic cocktail of gin or vodka with dry vermouth, often garnished with an olive.

clue.text: Cows maybe man's seen on road

parts.note: he is the pronoun for a man
Rd is the abbreviation for road

explanation.surface: A farmer's livestock wanders along the road.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'on' puts the first piece above the second.
explanation.definitionFit: A herd is a large group of animals kept together; cattle are the classic example, hence maybe.

clue.text: One with anecdotes and race to run in medley?

indicators.note: a medley is a jumbled mixture, so the letters are mixed up

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: An athlete in a medley relay with plenty of stories to tell.
explanation.definitionFit: A raconteur is a person skilled at telling amusing stories, so a fund of anecdotes is the defining trait.

clue.text: Agree to provide ring

definitions.meaning: first meaning: to be in harmony, as when views match
second meaning: the sound of a bell

explanation.surface: Someone consents to hand over a wedding band.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both to harmonise with another opinion and to sound like a bell striking.

clue.text: Peculiar spirit

definitions.meaning: first meaning: odd, strange (a chiefly British informal use)
second meaning: the liquor distilled from sugar cane

explanation.walkthrough: Peculiar spirit reads like a strange ghost; the two words are separate meanings.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is British slang for odd and also the name of a sugar-cane liquor.

clue.text: Succeed in returning debt and retire here?

indicators.note: in places the word for succeed inside the other piece
returning means going back, so the word for debt is read backwards

parts.note: taken as written
to win is to succeed

explanation.surface: Clear your debts successfully and you can retire in comfort.
explanation.walkthrough: Retire here means go to bed; the question mark admits the definition is by example.
explanation.definitionFit: To retire is to go to sleep for the night, and one of a matching pair of single beds is a place to do that.

clue.text: Former community superior

definitions.meaning: second meaning: the head of a religious house

explanation.surface: An ex-leader of the local group.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means earlier in time and also names a monk who heads a monastery or ranks below an abbot.

clue.text: Arguing on regular basis for continuous sequence

indicators.note: on a regular basis means at even intervals, so every other letter is taken

parts.note: the second, fourth and sixth letters of Arguing

explanation.surface: Constantly bickering, one quarrel after another.
explanation.definitionFit: A run is an unbroken series of events, such as a winning streak or a run of good luck.

clue.text: One claiming to predict future meeting editor? Get very angry

parts.note: a seer is a prophet or fortune-teller
ed is the abbreviation for editor

explanation.surface: A fortune-teller who meets the editor knows a row is coming.
explanation.definitionFit: To see red is the idiom for losing one's temper, from the red cape said to enrage a bull.

clue.text: From nation in South, rainy? Wrong!

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for South

indicators.note: something wrong is in the wrong order, so the letters before it are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A forecaster in the south predicts rain and is told they are wrong.
explanation.definitionFit: Syrian is the adjective for something coming from Syria, a nation in the Middle East.
